films.title: Troy
films.description: Peter O'Toole's Priam kneels in Achilles' tent — the ransom of Hector restaged as the film's quietest mercy.

popCulture.title: Priam
popCulture.description: The old king who kisses the hands that killed his sons — Book XXIV's ransom remains antiquity's great scene of pity.

popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.description: The poem ends not with Troy's fall but with shared grief over Hector's body — Priam and Achilles at one table.
